title: Closing down the first base and transfer to the second base

tellings.quote: That base is actually I I close that base down. um the base itself closed, the entire base, not just our aspect of it.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, a US spy agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, says that in the early 1990s he closed down the first base where his secret programme ran. He says the whole base closed, not just his part of it, and he moved on to a second base. If true, it would place a hidden alien-contact programme inside ordinary military bases.
